review_type: fresh source-only peer review; no native browser, build, or heavy test run
scope: member Profile and genuine Chrome extension reload adaptation of tests/browser/profile-native-acceptance.mjs
verdict_a_basis: The member path reuses existing first-party magic-link authentication, binds the extension profile to the first-party user, verifies the canonical admins read returned zero rows, and checks rendered nonadmin identity and selected organization.

The reload path clicks Chrome's extension-management Reload control, requires retirement of both original targets, a replacement worker and panel, and an actual SIDE_PANEL runtime context. Warm and reload rows are recorded separately; panel reopen alone is not counted as extension reload.

The runner verifies the imported CI receipt, source SHA, run ID, artifact ID, manifest, and tree before browser launch. The builder separately imported and verified product artifact source 2efd0e61 from CI run 37151712068, artifact 11283649857, tree ab10b6a8227b4288749ada2815ac4acf6eefccfcefe2cbf766235490d1d223a5. The test-only runner commit does not itself require a new product build if product source hashes are identical. This review did not independently inspect that import or execute native acceptance.

If the owner's Profile row is absent before the run, save/discard creates a row and restoring an empty Preferred value does not restore the original absence. A passing result could leave a persistent record that did not exist before the test.

verdict_b_findings.finding: The report writes identity.userId as owned_test_row_user_id_private when the initial owner row is absent. A private user identifier must not enter the report, regardless of its key name.

The original-row-absent branch has no cleanup that deletes the test-created row or refuses the mutation. Restoring only Preferred can leave a new owner row and fails the original-state preservation requirement.

The source review does not establish any native acceptance pass. Product artifact source 2efd0e61 was reported verified after this peer's original artifact read. The later 1aa16b6c worker-retirement helper change has not received this peer's source review. Report rows remain unverified until a guarded native run and independent evidence examination.

positive_controls: No product Profile handler or identity stub was introduced.
T25 uses CDP Fetch.failRequest only against the real owner profile GET and checks recovery through a subsequent successful owner read.

The save/discard diagnostic stages use redacted state booleans and check real profile GET and POST responses before case rows are marked passed; the separate missing-row report field still violates the privacy requirement.
